title: ArtStakes
tagline: stake nft's on one chain, have erc20's ripe for claiming on another chain
description: A new platform enabling collectors and digital art enthusiasts to tokenize and transfer their tokens onto other chains, dao-ifying historical nft's and allowing creative new use cases with tokens representing nft's, as well as even more creative use cases such as bridging their nft's onto new chains, safely interacting with them while retaining ownership
how_its_made: using the power of smart contracts, along with a some of foundry's forge, cast and chisel I have come up with a set of contracts allowing anyone to tokenize their nft's onto erc20 tokens on an l2, with set of functions and restrictions, users will be able to play around with their corresponding erc20's, while retaining ownership of their nft's
